purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Tima

queries.query: Tima Egypt official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) services and map pages. ESA describes cadastral/property map production and digital map products, but the search did not establish a public Tima parcel feature endpoint or downloadable safe parcel geometry.

queries.query: طيما سوهاج خريطة كادسترية سجل الأراضي جهاز رسمي GIS
queries.result: وجد البحث صفحات رسمية لهيئة المساحة المصرية وخدمات الخرائط الرقمية والخرائط المساحية، مع إشارات إلى السجلات والخرائط العقارية؛ لم يثبت البحث خدمة عامة مجهولة الوصول تُرجع قطعًا عقارية آمنة لمدينة طما/طيما.

registryEvidence.basis: The official national Egyptian Survey Authority is evidenced as the cadastral/topographic map producer and provider of map services, but no Tima-specific local registry/map viewer or public parcel layer was established.

officialSources.observation: Official ESA services page lists paper, digital, and historical maps, coordinate certificates, and surveying-related procedures; it does not expose a public parcel feature service.
Official ESA map section loaded successfully; page navigation exposes map products, not an anonymous parcel API.
Official digital-map sales page loaded successfully; it provides a product/service route rather than a public Tima parcel query endpoint.
Official ESA page describes agricultural land-possession mapping and integration of government spatial data; no anonymous parcel response was exposed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Egyptian Survey Authority national map/cadastral services as described by official first-party pages.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded or point-bounded anonymous cadastral parcel ID-plus-geometry response was retrieved for Tima.

remainingUncertainty: ESA may provide digital cadastral products or controlled services through request, purchase, authentication, or undiscovered application routes. A single WUP point and the absence of a public response do not establish citywide absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or private data were used.
